violet-partners: Heads-up: NexusAI wants to list a hosted API and a downloadable BYOW bundle. Their unique asks: (1) escrow with release tied to signed addendum OR compliance cert, (2) watermarking that must not change canonical digest, (3) optional TEE-sealed runtime key. Need legal+SI+HW alignment for gating and announcement sequencing.

rahul-legal: Hosted API OK. BYOW requires redistribution addendum and escrow terms. For escrow release triggers we'll accept 'addendum_signed' or an accredited compliance attestation. Require partner to provide signed reconstruction_proof and maintain signature audit logs for 18 months. Add indemnity for provenance misclaims.

sam-solutions: SI needs a canonical bundle: artifact.tar.gz, manifest.json (provenance_chain, signatures, kms_refs, rotation_history), detached signature, watermark metadata file, verification script. Workflow: verify canonical digest before applying watermark. Also require instructions for sealed-key lifecycle if using TEE.

diego-hw: HW notes: TEE-sealed runtime key OK (SGX/SEV). Need sealed-key lifecycle docs, recommended TTLs (default 1h), and re-seal guidance for restarts. For validation we'll run a smoke test on EdgeRack; partner should upload artifacts to secure bucket. Also record firmware/psp versions.

violet-partners: Partner sent a small mock manifest snippet showing fields; they can provide PGP detached sigs, a timestamped reconstruction_proof from escrow, and attest they won't alter canonical bits when watermarking. They asked if we can list hosted API Day 0 and show BYOW as "Request access" until escrow+addendum land.

rahul-legal: That approach is fine. Addendum will require: manifest schema, escrow provider acceptance criteria, release triggers, rotation audit retention (18 months), watermark warranty (canonical digest unchanged), and demo checklist preventing key exposure. I'll draft addendum template by Tue COB.

sam-solutions: Agreed. Docs action: add a verification quickstart (gpg --verify, sha256sum) and an example script for verifying reconstruction_proof from escrow. We'll stub the PR.

diego-hw: I'll schedule a 2hr validation window next Wed. Partner to upload artifacts by Mon EOD.

ops-bot: created ticket PARTNERS-5720 for NexusAI BYOW escrow + TEE flow  https://redwood.company/issue/PARTNERS-5720

violet-partners: Recap: Rahul draft addendum, Sam prep SI bundle + docs stub, Diego confirm HW slot, partner to upload artifacts. We'll reconvene after addendum + artifacts land. Thanks.
